opening.argument: The creator presents EazyBot as passive income, reporting that it makes a profit “week by week day by day” and nearly $30 that day. The dashboard displays multiple cryptocurrency bot entries, profit figures, and an “Add Funds To Wallet” control, while another comparison shows theoretical bot results against Buy & Hold results based on a $1,000 initial investment. Viewers are directed to a linked destination to test or register for the bot, and the description discloses that marked links are affiliate advertising supporting the speaker's investments. Although the material warns that cryptocurrency can cause a total loss and that past performance is not a reliable guide to future development, those limitations do not remove the affiliate solicitation built around recurring performance figures.
